title: Priya and the Lost Red Boot

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=30 beats='first snow blankets Maple Hill; Priya and her little brother Arjun whoosh down the sled run one last time, laughing; fat flakes fall fast and Mom said be home before the streetlights wink on'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=38 beats='at the bottom Arjun wiggles one bare striped sock; the red boot with the yellow star is gone somewhere along the sled run; falling snow will soon hide everything, so Priya must pick a plan fast'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='Priya takes Arjun mittened hand and squeaks partway up the packed run; two clues appear, drag marks sliding off the run edge toward the pine trees, and the huge bottom drift below with the dent where Arjun tumbled off; the falling snow is softening both, so Priya can chase only one'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=30 beats='the drag marks slide toward the pines while a blue jay scolds overhead; at a fallen log the trail splits, small fox paw prints hop one way and jay feathers and seed husks scatter the other'>>

choices.label: Pick a trail at the log

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=38 beats='Arjun grips Priya sleeve at the fallen log; the fox prints hop neatly into the blue pine shadows; the noisy jay flits from branch to branch the other way, fluffed up and loud, as if it wants to be followed'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=30 beats='a narrow deer path threads the pines; Priya wraps her scarf around Arjun cold sock; ahead rises a snowy mound with a dark round doorway, a fox den, and something small and red rests on its roof'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=38 beats='the red boot with the yellow star sits on the den roof, half filled with snow; two pointed ears poke up from the doorway below; Arjun presses both mittens over his mouth to hold in a squeal'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Priya lifts the boot slow as a falling snowflake; the fox only blinks and yawns; she shakes out the snow, warms Arjun foot with both hands, and slides the boot on; they whisper thank you toward the den and reach home just as the streetlights wink on'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Priya peeks past the boot into the den and three fuzzy fox kits blink back at her; she lifts the boot gently while Arjun waves a tiny hello; they tiptoe away, buckle the boot on his cold foot, and race home carrying the best secret on Maple Hill'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=30 beats='the jay leads them around the pines into a quiet clearing with one tall spruce; high on a springy branch, swinging in the wind, hangs the red boot with the yellow star, well past mitten reach'>>

choices.label: Find a way to reach it

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=38 beats='every gust flips the boot a little higher on the springy branch; the jay perches beside it looking proud of its shiny red treasure; Arjun jumps and jumps below while the sky turns dim pink'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='three soft snowballs and the boot pops off the branch, spins in the air, and plops deep into the powder with a poof; the jay squawks; digging it out takes a long cold while, so Priya and Arjun hurry home with the found boot, a little late and very snowy'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='the wind will not drop the boot and the light is nearly gone; Priya ties her spare red mitten to the spruce trunk to mark the tree and pulls Arjun home on the sled, his sock wrapped snug in her scarf; tomorrow after breakfast they will come back with Dad and the long rake'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=30 beats='at the bottom every sled crashes into one giant drift taller than Priya; Arjun points at the dent where he tumbled off on their last ride; the snow falls faster and starts to fill the dent in'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=38 beats='Priya sizes up the giant drift; she could dig right at the crash dent with her mittens before the snow fills it, or run to the warming hut and borrow a shovel from Mr. Okafor first'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=30 beats='Priya digs at the crash dent; the snow is packed like cold cake; she uncovers a candy wrapper, then a little snow cave where dark shapes hide, a lost hat and something wedged deep that glows red'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=38 beats='the red boot is wedged under a hard crust ledge deep in the little snow cave; one strong pull could pop it free or bring the drift wall slumping down; Arjun holds Priya other hand tight'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='pop, the boot bursts free in a shower of snow and Priya thumps down laughing; they shake it empty, rub Arjun toes warm, and buckle the boot on his hopping foot; two sets of boot prints march up the lane and home before the streetlights wink on'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='the drift groans and slumps, burying the boot arm deep in heavy snow just as the light fades; Priya plants a tall stick to mark the spot, wraps Arjun sock in her scarf, and pulls him home on the sled; the boot must wait under the drift until morning'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=18 beats='Mr. Okafor is scraping the warming hut steps; he lends Priya his small blue shovel and tucks a warm hand warmer into each of her mittens'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=50 beats='back at the drift Priya scoops a neat wide ring the way Mr. Okafor showed her and the red boot lifts out dry and whole; a warm hand warmer goes inside before it buckles onto Arjun hopping foot; they return the little blue shovel with a cheer and march home before the streetlights wink on'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=22 beats='the hill kids crowd around; big Jo with the green sled remembers Arjun boot flying off near the bumpy jump at noon'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='Jo leads everyone toward the bumpy jump; a rider named Sana saw the boot fly high, maybe somebody hung it in the maple by the jump, or maybe a grown-up dropped it in the rope hut lost-and-found basket; the light is going, so Priya picks where to look'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=30 beats='the whole pack of kids tramps past the bumpy jump, its ice ramp shiny with new snow; Sana points to where the boot sailed like a little red bird; ahead the old maple by the jump wears white sleeves on every branch'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=24 beats='the red boot with the yellow star dangles from a low maple branch just past mitten reach; Jo offers a boost while the other kids circle under it'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Jo boosts Priya up and she hooks the boot with two fingers; down it comes to a huge cheer; Arjun stomps his warm booted feet all the way home, telling Mom the maple tree tried to keep his boot and big Jo helped rescue it before the streetlights'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='six kids bend the springy branch low, slow and giggling, until the boot drops right into Priya open mittens; high fives go all around the maple; walking home under the first streetlights, Priya thanks every helper on Maple Hill by name and Arjun wiggles his warm toes'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=18 beats='Priya and the kids slide along the humming tow rope to the little hut; by its door sits the lost-and-found basket, heaped high with mittens, hats, and scarves'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=50 beats='under a green scarf at the very bottom of the basket sits the red boot with the yellow star; Priya shakes out the snow, rubs Arjun toes warm, and buckles the boot on; they thank the rope hut man and every helper, then stomp home before the streetlights wink on'>>
